clauses.title: Service Levels
clauses.text: DataSync warrants 99.5% uptime measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance windows of up to four (4) hours per week.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: DataSync's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the lesser of (i) fees paid by Customer in the three (3) months preceding the claim or (ii) ten thousand US dollars ($10,000).

clauses.title: Data Processing
clauses.text: DataSync will process Customer Data solely to provide the Services. Customer represents and warrants that it has obtained all necessary consents from data subjects.

clauses.title: Termination for Convenience
clauses.text: DataSync may terminate this Agreement at any time upon thirty (30) days written notice. Customer may terminate only at the end of the then-current Term upon ninety (90) days notice.

risk_findings.risk: Liability cap below industry norm (3 months / $10K)
Burden of obtaining data subject consent shifted entirely to Customer
